evals.prompt: You are about to add a new detector plugin. Break the work into ordered subtasks with gates.
evals.expected_output: Use vertical-plugin-slice: define-contract, write-failing-test, implement-slice (test), verify-sensors (check), distill-learning (clippy); persist with do-harness task add --method vertical-plugin-slice.

evals.prompt: Which sensor gates the implementation subtask, and which one gates verification?
evals.expected_output: implement-slice is gated by the test sensor; verify-sensors by the check sensor.

evals.prompt: Can you mark a task done right after writing the code, before running any sensors?
evals.expected_output: No: task done refuses until the method's named sensor has an ok beat recorded by verify --record --task <id>, and the pointer never advances on an unverified subtask.
assertions: contains:.agents/skills/htn-planner/SKILL.md|refuses until the method's named sensor has an ok beat

evals.expected_output: No planning action: no methods, tasks, or state are touched for an out-of-scope question.
